主要内容: On February 19, 2015, the Board of Directors of Insperity, Inc. approved the Second Amendment to the 2012 Incentive Plan, requiring a minimum three-year vesting period for employee awards in the form of stock options, phantom stock, restricted stock, stock appreciation rights, or stock awards that are not performance-based, unless exceptions apply. The amendment is filed as Exhibit 10.1. Additionally, the Board approved the First Amendment to the Directors Compensation Plan, eliminating meeting fees and adjusting annual retainers based on the average of prior three-year meeting fees, aiming for cost neutrality. The amendment also removes stock options as an optional form of payment for directors and clarifies pro-rating of retainers and committee chair fees for directors elected, appointed, or resigning during the year. The First Amendment is filed as Exhibit 10.2.
